Remark
[Criterion for canonical Ricci flow with surgery] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0233, page-0234 1. ch22:22.22\group Uniqueness

The chapter proposes that a canonical Ricci flow with surgery on closed three-manifolds should have the property that an isometry between open subsets at one time determines an isometry of the universal covers at every time, including across surgery times.
